description: Paving patterns read from the SCNU 360 VR tour (visual reference only, nothing copied): module sizes, bonds, colours and accent shares of the campus walks and plazas, drawn by lib/pavingPatterns.mjs as repeating colour + relief tiles (no photo pixel). Colours are sRGB estimates from the VR faces under daylight; module sizes are counted against known lengths (bay widths, steps, the 0.3 m tactile module). Every value is an estimate (추정).

campus-speckle.label: light grey 0.3 m concrete pavers with scattered dark grey and blue-grey squares (campus sidewalk standard)
campus-speckle.source: VR scene_a2 d, scene_a3 d/l, scene_a4 d, scene_b2 d, scene_b4 d, scene_c2 d, scene_d1 d, scene_e3 d, scene_e5 r

plaza-mottled.label: central plaza: 0.5 m granite squares mixed light, mid and dark grey with dark slate squares
plaza-mottled.source: VR scene_c1 d/r/b and scene_e1 f/r/d (the pond plaza)

brick-herringbone.label: red clay brick 0.2 x 0.1 m in a 90 degree herringbone
brick-herringbone.source: VR scene_c1 f (the forecourt below the library steps)

pink-paver.label: pink-red concrete pavers 0.2 x 0.1 m in running bond
pink-paver.source: VR scene_b7 l/d (walks around B7), scene_a1 l (the walk north of the fountain pond), scene_e5 r (entrance forecourt)

dorm-blue.label: dorm plaza: blue-grey 0.4 m pavers with a small terracotta square on a 1.2 m grid
dorm-blue.source: VR scene_a9 d/b, scene_a10 d/l (the A9 tree plaza)

d4-stripes.label: D4 plaza: light grey running-bond pavers, navy and salmon accents; five surveyed band axes in parcel-curation.json d4GroundTruth
d4-stripes.source: VR scene_d4 f/d; refs/h-scnu-vr/d4_f_plaza_paving_trees.jpg; SYNTHESIS section 4 and material rows 14-16: rectangular 2:1 stretcher pavers read against 0.3 m tactile modules, daylight-neutral light grey / navy / salmon palette and accent shares by eye; 3.6 m periodic navy stripe retained only until finite PV-B1..B5 pairs are consumed from parcel-curation.json d4GroundTruth (estimated)

d4-passage-stone.label: D4 passage: grey stone slabs; white painted grid is separate finite geometry
d4-passage-stone.source: VR scene_d4 f; SYNTHESIS section 8 row 12, refs/c-bridge/src-03-passage-eye-level-through.jpg: large grey slabs; nominal 0.6 m module and 8 mm joints by comparison with plaza modules, not a measured slab grid (estimated)

e7-white.label: near-white 0.3 m pavers with scattered dark grey, blue and terracotta squares
e7-white.source: VR scene_e7 f/d (the E7 front plaza)

slab-grey.label: large light grey concrete slabs 0.6 m
slab-grey.source: VR scene_b2 f (B2 forecourt), scene_f1 f (F1 forecourt), scene_d2 f/r (D2 courtyard), scene_e1 f (forecourt south of the central plaza)

slate-band.label: dark slate band 0.3 x 0.6 m
slate-band.source: VR scene_c1 d (the band around the pool), scene_d2 f (courtyard borders)

grey-band.label: mid grey border pavers 0.3 x 0.6 m
grey-band.source: VR scene_c1 f (borders of the brick forecourt)

gate-bands.label: gate plaza: light grey 0.6 m slabs with 1.2 m blue-grey bands across the plaza every 2.4 m
gate-bands.source: VR scene_a19 l/f (the finished SW gate plaza; the 2025 sheet shows the bands at its road edge, the rest under construction)
